_comment: IRN Store catalog. This file is the ALLOWLIST: the root helper
(/usr/local/libexec/irn-store-install) refuses any package name that does
not appear here, so the store cannot be talked into installing something
arbitrary. Everything listed is packaged by Debian — no third-party apt
sources, no Flathub, no new trust relationships.
To add an app: put it in a section below and rebuild the ISO.

categories.name: IRN tools
categories.note: Built into the image. Listed so the store is a complete map of what is here.
